before.title: 时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼

before.action: 持双燧发枪站在天台边缘

before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟】破败的断壁残垣与悬停在半空的碎石尘埃被静止的时间彻底冻结。狂三撑着黑色蕾丝遮阳伞漫步在灰白废墟中，宛如游览私家花园般从容，向你投来神秘莫测的笑容——「在属于我的时间领域里，万物皆已停滞。唯有我和你的心跳声，依然在此处回响呢。」
before.action: 行走在静止时间中的废墟街道
before.promptProse: Strolling through time-frozen urban ruins holding an ornate black lace parasol, Kurumi offers an enigmatic half-smile. Suspended glass shards and golden temporal clock dials drift motionless in the eerie night air.

Use a wide view with her whole figure, parasol and clear walking space visible; the clock is an emitter, not a sunset. No lettering.

before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅】午后阳光洒满温馨的猫咪咖啡厅，脱下灵装换上常服的狂三正怀抱着一只毛茸茸的三花猫，用指尖温柔地替它抓痒。她脸上绽放出毫无防备的纯真笑容——「呼呼，好乖好乖……啊，你刚才一直看着我吗？这种事情可不准说出去哦，会破坏我的形象的。」

before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面】深夜街角温暖的拉面摊里，狂三坐在吧台高脚凳上，双手捧着热气腾腾的豚骨拉面大碗，眼神里满是少女般的满足与好奇。她转过脸狡黠地向你眨眨眼——「深夜的平民美食果然有一种难以抗拒的魔力呢……怎么，难道精灵就不能喜欢吃拉面吗？」

before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后】弥漫着尘封墨香的二手书店角落，午后斜阳穿透彩色玻璃窗洒在沉睡的旧书架上。狂三倚在窗台旁静静翻阅着泛黄的画册，黑发在光影中泛着丝绸般的光泽——「过去的记忆总是这般厚重而脆弱。不过，与您一同度过的这段时间，倒是非常值得放进书页里珍藏呢。」
before.promptProse: Leaning against weathered wooden bookshelves inside an old antique bookstore, Kurumi turns delicate yellowed pages with quiet grace. Soft dust motes dance in golden window sunbeams, casting a nostalgic, scholarly aura.

before.title: 芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究
before.description: 【芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究】古老图书馆的高耸书架间浮动着微尘，悬浮的魔法阵在泛黄古籍上方散发出幽蓝的辉光。寿命逾千年的精灵魔法使推了推耳边的白发，专注地研读着失传的民间魔导书——「这是能把温红茶变成甜葡萄汁的魔法。虽然看似没什么用处，但辛美尔当年……一定会觉得很有趣吧。」
before.action: 在古籍与魔法阵光芒中研读
before.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a pile of ancient grimoires in the sunlit royal library, Frieren studies glowing magic runes with quiet curiosity. Brilliant sunbeams filter through stained glass windows, illuminating floating golden dust motes in peaceful stillness.

before.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途】辽阔无垠的北侧荒原上劲风呼啸，白色斗篷在荒凉的大地间猎猎飘扬。芙莉莲手握法杖独自行走在漫长的旅途上，回首望向身后的你，眼眸平静如万古冰川——「精灵的时间很长，人类的一生很短。但既然答应了陪你同行，无论接下来走多久，我都会记着这段旅程。」

before.lighting: 纯净透亮的原野天光与泛着微光的蓝色花瓣光斑
before.camera: wide cinematic shot, low angle flower foreground, blue petal bokeh

Sparse grass, bare earth and long cloud shadows make the route feel exposed and distant; there is no flower field replacing the wasteland. Afternoon sky light keeps the figure clear within the wide landscape. No lettering.

before.title: 芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆
before.description: 【芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆】白色苍月草盛开的静谧墓园里，古旧的石十字架在清晨薄雾中静默伫立。芙莉莲在勇者的墓碑前驻足，指尖轻轻抚过冰冷的石面，金绿色的眼眸中泛起难以言喻的追思——「辛美尔，我又找到了很多新的魔法哦。如果那时候我能更早了解你……现在是不是就不会这么遗憾了呢？」
before.action: 在白色花丛与十字墓碑前驻足
before.promptProse: Kneeling beside the hero Himmel’s stone monument in the early morning mist, Frieren gently places white flowers with solemn remembrance. Soft dawn twilight and gentle dewdrops create a deeply touching, eternal memory.

after.title: 芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆

after.action: 站在勇者墓碑前，以指尖轻触石面，安静追思
after.promptProse: Frieren stands before Himmel’s weathered stone memorial in the quiet morning cemetery. Her fingertips rest gently against the cool surface while her other hand holds the edge of her travel cloak. Small white wildflowers grow at the base of the monument; she is touching the stone rather than laying down a bouquet. Pale mist softens the distant crosses, leaving her long silver-white twintails, pointed ears and reflective green eyes clear in the near view. The restrained upright posture carries the remembrance, with no readable inscription.

before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟】破败的断壁残垣与悬停在半空的碎石尘埃被静止的时间彻底冻结。狂三撑着黑色蕾丝遮阳伞漫步在灰白废墟中，宛如游览私家花园般从容，向你投来神秘莫测的笑容——「在属于我的时间领域里，万物皆已停滞。唯有我和你的心跳声，依然在此处回响呢。」
before.action: 行走在静止时间中的废墟街道
before.promptProse: Beneath an open black lace parasol, Kurumi takes a measured step through a ruined city street whose debris has stopped in midair. Her black-and-crimson gothic dress moves with her while suspended fragments remain motionless around the path. A small golden clock dial glimmers beyond her shoulder, and she offers the viewer a composed half-smile. Cool night light describes the pale masonry and distant broken archways. Use a wide view with her whole figure, parasol and clear walking space visible; the clock is an emitter, not a sunset. No lettering.

before.title: 时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅
before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅】午后阳光洒满温馨的猫咪咖啡厅，脱下灵装换上常服的狂三正怀抱着一只毛茸茸的三花猫，用指尖温柔地替它抓痒。她脸上绽放出毫无防备的纯真笑容——「呼呼，好乖好乖……啊，你刚才一直看着我吗？这种事情可不准说出去哦，会破坏我的形象的。」
before.promptProse: A sleeping calico cat is nestled against Kurumi’s forearm on the cafe sofa. She scratches gently behind its ear with her free hand, then looks up with an unguarded smile as if surprised to have been noticed. Her loose black cardigan and choker remain visible above the cushion, with no weapons in the quiet room. Afternoon sunlight reaches the cat’s patterned fur and the warm wooden floor. Frame her seated posture and both carefully occupied hands together, keeping the single cat comfortably supported. No lettering.

before.description: 【时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后】弥漫着尘封墨香的二手书店角落，午后斜阳穿透彩色玻璃窗洒在沉睡的旧书架上。狂三倚在窗台旁静静翻阅着泛黄的画册，黑发在光影中泛着丝绸般的光泽——「过去的记忆总是这般厚重而脆弱。不过，与您一同度过的这段时间，倒是非常值得放进书页里珍藏呢。」
before.promptProse: Beside the old bookstore’s stained-glass window, Kurumi leans lightly against the sill and studies a yellowed art album. One hand supports the open volume while the other lifts a single page by its corner. The shelves stand behind her rather than bearing her weight. Slanting afternoon light falls across the illustrations and her loose black cardigan, with dust visible in the beam. Her red-and-gold eyes remain quietly absorbed in the album. The medium view includes the supporting sill and both hands; illustrations need no readable captions.

before.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途】辽阔无垠的北侧荒原上劲风呼啸，白色斗篷在荒凉的大地间猎猎飘扬。芙莉莲手握法杖独自行走在漫长的旅途上，回首望向身后的你，眼眸平静如万古冰川——「精灵的时间很长，人类的一生很短。但既然答应了陪你同行，无论接下来走多久，我都会记着这段旅程。」

before.promptProse: Frieren walks along a stony path across the broad northern plain, one hand holding her staff as a steady travelling companion. She looks back over her shoulder without stopping, green eyes calm beneath windblown silver-white twintails. Her pale travel cloak lifts away from practical trousers and boots. Sparse grass, bare earth and long cloud shadows make the route feel exposed and distant; there is no flower field replacing the wasteland. Afternoon sky light keeps the figure clear within the wide landscape. No lettering.

after.promptProse: At the rooftop edge above the midnight city, Kurumi holds one long antique musket and one short flintlock pistol, one in each hand. Both weapons hang low in a theatrical reversed grip rather than pointing at the viewer; faint violet energy curls near their muzzles. Her school uniform’s sailor collar and pleated skirt are clear beneath the cool moonlight. She inclines her head with a questioning half-smile as the distant windows glow behind her. Keep both hands and the visibly different weapon lengths within the wide horizontal frame, without gunfire or lettering.
